files.installs/ark/worldcradle-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed ARK server — generated by provision().
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
mkdir -p "<ROOT>/installs/ark/cluster"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/ark/" || exit 1
exec ./ShooterGame/Binaries/Linux/ShooterGameServer \
  "TheIsland_WP?listen?SessionName=Test World?MaxPlayers=10?ServerPassword=${GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD}?ServerAdminPassword=${GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD}?Port=7790?QueryPort=27030?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort=27040?AltSaveDirectoryName=wc_test?ServerPVE=True" \
  -server -log -clusterid=worldcradle -ClusterDirOverride="<ROOT>/installs/ark/cluster" -NoTransferFromFiltering
files.installs/ark/worldcradle-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
"<PYTHON>" - 27040 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<APP>')
import monitor
for cmd in ['SaveWorld', 'DoExit']:
    monitor.source_rcon(int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], cmd, timeout=15)
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 115 ] && pgrep -f -- 'AltSaveDirectoryName=wc_test\?' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
